name: Global Dial
summary: Perth ISP and telecommunications carrier (Global Dial Pty Ltd). Founded Sep 1994 by Patrick Ng; operated under the trading/portal names 'Global Dial Internet' and 'The Global Dial Internet Team' (globalweb.com.au member portal). Top-rated ISP in the Internet.AU survey (Mar 1998); first WA ISP with satellite (1999); carrier licence + telephony (2000); WA State Government ISP panel (1998). Earlier 1997 APNIC-era allocations GLOBALWEB-AU / GLOBWEB-AU (Nedlands WA). Acquired by ZettaNet Pty Ltd (trading as Highway 1) 1 Jun 2010 (ZANTICO CORPORATION PTY LTD, ACN 063 959 795).

events.details: Top-rated ISP in the Internet.AU independent survey (Mar 1998 edition); included on the WA State Government ISP panel for all four categories (dial-up, email, consultancy, web design). First WA ISP to offer satellite connections (1999); registered carrier licence with residential/corporate telephony (2000), expanding to Sydney and Melbourne. Operated the 'Global Dial Internet Team' customer portal at globalweb.com.au (contact page: 13 30 13, 278 Stirling Highway, Claremont WA).
